existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `GuidanceResponse` has local R4-to-R6 breaking changes despite retaining the same resource identity. The main concerns are the `reasonCode`/`reasonReference` merge into `reason`, `evaluationMessage` becoming single-valued, and `result` replacing `RequestGroup` with R6 request resources while also becoming repeatable. Confidence is high for the structural deltas; migration rationale would be improved by official diff notes.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration should focus on deterministic element transforms rather than whole-resource identity changes. `reasonCode` maps naturally to `reason.concept`, and `reasonReference` maps to `reason.reference`, but R6 can express paired concept/reference reasons and references outside the old R4 target set. `evaluationMessage` requires a policy for multiple messages. `result` requires both `RequestGroup` to `RequestOrchestration` handling and R6-to-R4 loss handling for multiple or newly allowed target resources.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high because the local R4 and R6 StructureDefinitions are present, complete, and directly comparable, and the required `guidance-response-status` CodeSystems are complete with identical code concepts. Confidence is lower only for inferred design intent and for precise operational migration guidance because no official diff, ballot rationale, or cross-version ConceptMap was supplied.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
GuidanceResponse keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 3 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 0 potential hard break(s), 2 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 0 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 2, which creates neutral stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 38/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

4 finding(s) identify a yes/partial less-breaking base-design alternative, so the aggregate should not be used to dismiss local avoidability review.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: evaluationMessage maximum cardinality decreased from many to one
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances with more than one `evaluationMessage` repetition exceed the R6 maximum of one. Runtime/API/codegen also changes from list handling to a nullable singleton.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R4 reasonCode and reasonReference were merged into R6 reason CodeableReference
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `reasonCode` and `reasonReference` properties are not R6 GuidanceResponse elements. There is also runtime/API/codegen churn from two lists to one CodeableReference list and possible R6-to-R4 loss for paired or broader references.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: result targets changed from CarePlan or RequestGroup to a broad R6 request-resource set
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: under target-profile/resource-type validation, an R4 `result` reference to `RequestGroup/...` no longer conforms in R6. There is also runtime/API/codegen risk for changed target unions and R6-to-R4 loss for newly allowed target resources.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: result changed from single-valued to repeating
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: runtime/API/codegen: generated R6 models and application logic must treat `result` as a collection rather than a singleton. R6-to-R4 loss occurs when more than one result reference must be down-converted into the R4 single slot.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 adds optional GuidanceResponse.location
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: a populated R6 `location` cannot be represented in core R4 GuidanceResponse without an extension or external association. There is no old-valid/new-invalid R4-to-R6 mechanism.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
